title: Account Freeze Request Resolution
description: Standardized schema for account freeze ticket resolutions, normalizing outputs from five inconsistent developer implementations

ticket_id.description: Ticket identifier. Normalizes: ticketId, ticket.id, id, ticket_id, ticketRef

action.description: Account action to take. Normalizes: decision (FREEZE), outcome.action (freeze_all), result (frozen), freeze_type (full), recommendation.type (FREEZE)

affected_accounts.description: Account IDs affected. Normalizes: accounts (array), affected (comma-separated string), account_list (array of objects)

reason_code.description: Standardized reason category. Normalizes: why (text), reason (text), reason_code (numeric), reasonCode (enum string)

evidence_summary.description: Concise evidence summary. Normalizes: why, reason, notes, summary, evidence (array)

confidence_score.description: [INVENTED] Numeric confidence in this action (0–1). Only dev_b had this concept (0.91). Useful for routing high-confidence vs. review-needed cases.

timestamp.description: [INVENTED] ISO 8601 timestamp of decision. None of the 5 samples included audit timestamps—critical for compliance and debugging.

action_scope.description: [INVENTED] Scope of freeze action. dev_e had 'ALL_LINKED' concept, but scope wasn't consistently modeled. Clarifies intent.

additional_notes.description: Optional notes. dev_c had detailed 'notes' (dispute count, card status); dev_d had 'summary'. Preserved as optional catch-all.
